_comment: Hand-written homepage hero summaries, keyed by story slug. build-home-preview.mjs uses these instead of the automatic ~25-word cut (HomepageStructure.heroDeck). Display only: story text is never changed. Keep each 20-25 words, ending on a full stop, drawn only from the story text. The build warns when an automatic cut drops under 15 words so new packs get flagged for an entry here.

mantle-rock-and-the-trail-of-tears.heroDeck: Mantle Rock, a sandstone arch in Livingston County, stands near the old road that carried the Cherokee on the Trail of Tears in 1838–39.
mantle-rock-and-the-trail-of-tears.reason: Automatic clause cut gave 12 words ("West of the crossroads of Joy in Livingston County, off KY 133…"); Critiquito review of PR #191.
